ios.desc:
Celebrate Your Progress, One Badge at a Time!

Life isn't a checklist, it's a collection of your greatest achievements. Life Badger is your personal companion for celebrating that collection, turning your goals and milestones into a vibrant gallery of interactive, beautifully designed badges. It's the perfect tool for anyone who wants to see their journey visualized and feel the thrill of every accomplishment.

Key Features:

Collect Your Achievements as Badges: Go beyond simple lists. Whether it's the countries you've visited, the books you've read, or the skills you've mastered, Life Badger gives every accomplishment the beautiful badge it deserves. Create custom achievements for any passion.

Visualize Your Entire Journey: See your progress at a glance. A clear, intuitive interface with dynamic visuals and badge collections helps you monitor both daily habits and lifelong dreams, keeping you motivated every step of the way.

Make Every Badge Your Own: Personalize your achievements with custom titles, descriptions, and images that reflect your unique journey. Your passions are one-of-a-kind; your badges should be too.

Feel the Thrill of Accomplishment: Experience the joy of progress with stunning animations. Watch your badges rotate, shine, and come to life as you reach new milestones, giving you a satisfying burst of motivation.

A Seamless macOS Experience: Designed from the ground up for the Mac, iOS, and tvOS, Life Badger offers a clean, distraction-free interface that lets you focus on what matters most, your growth.

Why Choose Life Badger?

Life is about celebrating the things that matter to you, big or small. That's why Life Badger is flexible enough to track both daily habits, like fitness goals, and lifelong dreams, like visiting every National Park. As your interests and goals evolve, the app grows with you. It's the perfect companion for anyone who values personal growth and wants to make every step of their journey count.

With Life Badger, you're not just recording what you've done; you're building a beautiful legacy of your experiences. Whether you're a dedicated goal-setter, a keeper of precious memories, or someone who simply loves seeing tangible progress, Life Badger makes your journey fun, engaging, and deeply personal.

Start Your Achievement Journey Today

show_hn.title: Show HN: Life Badger – A To-Done App Instead of a To-Do App

quotes.text:
Over the past few years, I’ve built and released several indie apps, experimenting with different ideas and business models along the way. My latest project, Life Badger, is an achievement tracker that focuses on celebrating what you’ve done rather than just listing what you need to do. The idea started from a few very specific use cases—I wanted an application to track planes I’ve flown on, national parks I’ve visited, and theater shows I’ve seen.

The Problem with To-Do Apps

To-do apps are everywhere. They help organize tasks, prioritize work, and boost productivity. If you’re the kind of person who thrives on getting things done and checking off boxes, this can be done in more than one way. I want to avoid a cycle where progress feels like a never-ending obligation rather than a source of motivation.

I wanted to flip this concept on its head. Instead of focusing on what’s left to do, Life Badger is all about celebrating what you’ve already accomplished. The idea was simple: track achievements over time and turn them into something tangible, like a collection of digital badges that visually tell the story of your progress.

Building for Long-Term Motivation

The core design principle behind Life Badger was that some achievements happen daily, but others might take years. Maybe you’re tracking books you’ve read, national parks you’ve visited, or programming languages you’ve learned. Some of these lists update weekly, while others might only change every few years.
